findings.description: A full review where §4 legitimately gates out every area (e.g. a binary- or lockfile-only PR) now goes red with 'no reviewer was spawned; re-run', and since an errored record is never taken as reviewed, every re-run reproduces it; the skill (§4, §8 'a round that reviewed nothing') still allows zero spawns on a full review, so either require at least `conventions` there or relax the guard.

The `settings` comment says the action forwards only the names its own `env:` lists, not step `env:`, yet ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL are set as step `env:`; if the comment is right the alias pins never reach Claude Code and the tiers float silently. Moving both into the `settings` JSON `env` alongside CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS removes the doubt.

UNRETURNED_REVIEWERS is an English-prose heuristic that also matches notes from a finished clean review (e.g. 'none returned any findings', or §2's 'HEAD moved before the reviewers returned; re-checked'), turning a complete empty full review into 'Review incomplete', a red status and an errored record; it will also drift as orchestrator wording changes.

incompleteReason compares only array lengths, so returned `[correctness, correctness]` against spawned `[correctness, security]`, or a longer returned list with unspawned areas, passes as complete; a per-area multiset check would enforce the schema's 'by area as in reviewers_spawned'.

The opening `/** Whether a round's record covers every reviewer it spawned ... */` block is attached to no declaration, a file-header banner that core.md §Comments forbids; keep only its WHY on incompleteReason's doc comment or the regex comment.

The doc comments on incompleteReason and noVerdictReason are noun phrases (noVerdictReason's runs to six lines enumerating branches) rather than the imperative one-line summary core.md §Comments asks for.
incompleteReason is exported but its only production caller is noVerdictReason; per AGENTS.md §Altitude, either name its WHY or fold it into noVerdictReason and drop the export.

The test 'leaves a round with a verdict green in both scripts' asserts on both the poster and the metrics script, so either regression fails the same test; testing.md asks for one reason to fail per test, so split it per script.

bodyLines takes both summary and the derived noVerdict, so `summary === null` and the `?? "Not reviewed"` fallback are dead, and the full-vs-incremental zero-spawn rule is split between noVerdictReason and an unkeyed `reviewers_spawned.length === 0` branch that only works because the full case was filtered upstream.

Reason strings embed '; re-run' and counts and are reused verbatim as status description, ::error:: text, metrics incomplete_reason and bold body heading (which then adds its own re-run instruction), so the metrics field is not groupable and the body repeats itself; a short reason code would let each surface phrase it.

Unit and integration tests assert full reason prose (down to the trailing period added by bodyLines), so a rewording breaks several tests with no behaviour change; assert null vs non-null or a stable prefix and keep the exact text in one test.
README quotes a 'this PR has not been reviewed' verdict that no longer exists; bodyLines now renders 'Not reviewed: …; re-run.' or 'Review incomplete: N of M reviewers returned; re-run.'.

The retro skill describes the record's spawn shape as reviewers_spawned/reviewers_skipped and is_error as 'failed before producing output'; it now misses reviewers_returned, incomplete_reason, the hollow-round is_error case and schema_version 2.
The agent-frontmatter reference lists the `model` field but not the `effort:` key this PR adds to three review-agent manifests.
platform.is_error can mark a metrics record errored while the poster still sets a green claude-review status, so the two consumers can disagree on a round's outcome.
